english.title: Fail to comply with a notice to remove / alter a projection from a building
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), having been served with a notice under section 152(1) of the Highways Act 1980 requiring you to

(A)_[remove]_
(B)_[alter]_

(C)_[a porch]_
(D)_[a shed]_
(E)_[a projecting window]_
(F)_[a step]_
(G)_[a cellar]_
(H)_[a cellar door]_
(I)_[a cellar window]_
(J)_[a sign]_
(K)_[a signpost]_
(L)_[a sign iron]_
(M)_[a showboard]_
(N)_[a window shutter]_
(O)_[a wall]_
(P)_[a gate]_
(Q)_[a fence]_
(R)_[an obstruction, namely **(..SPECIFY OBSTRUCTION..)]_
(S)_[a projection, namely **(..SPECIFY PROJECTION..)]_

which had been erected or placed against or in front of a building, namely **(..SPECIFY BUILDING..), occupied by you and which was an obstruction to safe or convenient passage along a street, failed to comply with that notice within 14 days of the service of the notice on you
english.legislation: Contrary to section 152 (4) of the Highways Act 1980.

english.notes:
(i) Proceedings for this offence shall not without the written consent of the Attorney General, be taken by any person other than the person aggrieved, or a highway authority or council having an interest in the enforcement of the provision or byelaws in question - section 312 Highways Act 1980.
(ii) The meaning of "highway" is defined in section 328 Highways Act 1980.
